answer: Persistent Attention Beacon: each identity must emit a periodic beacon tied to a verifiable workload—solving challenge puzzles whose answers depend on its full prior history. A velvet penalty throttles beacon frequency for identities that skip cycles, so a swarm of fresh sybils can't accelerate to honest rate without sustained compute. Attacker cost: continuous per-identity compute plus forfeited plume of accumulated history, making mass fake identities linearly expensive over time.
